meta.scope: Iraq Batch 6 — External partners densification: China, Turkey, and broader trade/cooperation framing.

candidates.title: Iraq–China merchandise trade and cooperation framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from trade and bilateral sources
candidates.description: Bilateral trade and economic cooperation with China. China is a major destination for Iraqi crude and a large source of imports (machinery, equipment, consumer goods) and infrastructure investment interest.

candidates.title: Iraq–Turkey merchandise trade statistics
candidates.publisher: Derived from Turkish and Iraqi trade sources
candidates.description: Bilateral trade with Turkey. Turkey is a major source of Iraqi imports (food, construction materials, consumer goods, jewellery) and a destination for some refined products and transit; volumes are large and sensitive to border and security conditions.

candidates.title: Iraq external economic cooperation framing
candidates.description: System-level framing of Iraq’s network of joint economic commissions, bilateral cooperation agreements and preferential arrangements. Continuously cited in trade diversification, investment and reconstruction analysis.
candidates.notes: Overall external-architecture densification beyond pure oil exports.
